messages:
Alex Chen: Morning — quick async daybreak standup. Cut window in ~2h, canary originally at 11:15 PT. Need two cherry-pick confirmations (PR #4982, #4991), one reviewer for #4989, and a smoke run on the dedicated pool after canary. What are your blockers?
Maria Gomez: On it — cherry-pick for #4982 created and pushed to branch `cherry/4982-rebase`. Waiting on CI (integration flake).
Jamal Ortiz: I can take #4989 review in ~30m. Looks small from the diff.
Sophie Li: Seeing CI fail on #4991 with CUDA OOM in integration job:
```
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 1.2 GiB
    at build/inference_test.cpp:421
```
I'll try a local repro with reduced batch size; might be delayed ~1h.
Lee Parker: I have the canary node reserved, but GPU driver update is still rolling. @Alex Chen — can we nudge the canary 15m if Sophie needs time?
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: `release-canary-2026-05-09-1115` triggered by @Alex Chen. Status: queued.
Alex Chen: OK let's move canary to 11:30 PT. Sophie, if you can't get a clean repro in time, we'll skip #4991 from this canary and include it in the next wave.
Maria Gomez: CI passed on #4982, merging now.
Jamal Ortiz: Reviewed #4989, left one tiny comment on config naming. If Alex gives the go, I can approve after the comment is addressed and CI passes.
Sophie Li: Repro'd locally — root cause is a large batch in a test fixture. Pushed a fix, opened PR #4995 to clamp batch size and add an assertion. Running unit/integration locally now.
Alex Chen: Action items: 1) Jamal to finish review and approve #4989 (~30m), 2) Maria already merged #4982, 3) Sophie to either fix #4991 or we omit it from this canary, 4) Lee to trigger canary at 11:30 PT and post link. Please ping here when canary completes or if any new blockers.
Lee Parker: Will trigger at 11:30 and paste canary URL here.
deploy-bot: Canary started: `release-canary-2026-05-09-1130`. URL: https://deploys.internal/canary/3355001234
Alex Chen: Thanks team :rocket:
